text:
ana: heads up 5m: per-model cost card shows a consistent ~4% delta vs raw ledger during canary routing window. not huge but customers asked.
derek: sample id?
ana: `ev_20260322_1002`
ravi: see if cache-crediting logic applied for that route. we had a transform change yesterday to compress large meta objects.
sylvia: i scanned the events 5m and see nested `meta.route_id` present but top-level `route` field is empty. billing join uses top-level.
ops-bot: deploy 1720001256 econ-ingest-v2 -> canary succeeded :white_check_mark:
margo: UX note 5m: product wants an explanation on the card not just a badge. they want a link to a "how attribution works" doc and a small inline "why this might be wrong" blurb.
derek: technical fix: add map-transform to promote `meta.route_id` -> `route` at ingest where missing; plan backfill for last 72h. also add an aggregation that sums "attributed token_cost" vs "raw token_cost" and exposes `unattributed_pct` metric.
ravi: i'll add metric and Prom alert when unattributed_pct > 0.01 for any model-sku.
nana: cool. can we also show "unattributed" as a separate row in the per-model breakdown so teams can quickly see it? product supports that.
sylvia: agreed. i'll do the frontend changes.
nana: assign owners: ravi -> metric + backfill SQL, derek -> ingest transform code, sylvia -> console row + copy, margo -> doc snippet.
ops-bot: scheduled rollout in 20m: econ-ingest fix -> canary -> full.
